purpose: Canonical fixture paths, acceptance commands, expected exit codes, observed results, and invariants for the desktop v0.x release gates.

checks.note: Use the isolated CI harness; this can start Rails on port 3000 and must not run against the user's occupied development endpoint.

The Mac-only packaged smoke exercises the test-only app bundle: stage signed N, kill and restart N-1 with the verified cache, withdraw feed eligibility, restore it, simulate an unavailable feed during safe quit and verify the cache survives, defer quit during a dirty-save conflict, interrupt installation after modifying only the disposable staged copy, then verify N relaunch and source preservation. The interruption failpoint compiles only with the WebDriver feature. Hosted macOS execution is pending; production Stable DMG proof remains. Linux runs download verification only and has no self-installer.

checks.command: docker run --rm --pull=always --volume "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE:/workspace" --workdir /workspace --env ELEF_BUILD_SHA archlinux:base-devel bash desktop/scripts/arch_package_ci.sh
checks.note: Builds the native executable and versioned tar.zst archive in Arch, serves the exact asset locally to an unprivileged makepkg run, checks ELF dependencies and Arch package ownership, then installs, launches/quits, performs a pkgrel upgrade, verifies package-owned file hashes, and uninstalls. Hosted execution is pending.
Core tests cover all eight checked-in sentinel values, failure-category sanitization, hostile fields during ZIP export, and bounded rotation. Native menu/export runtime smoke remains.

package_pair_generator.limitation: The generator creates test-only WebDriver bundles (app bundle on macOS, AppImage on Linux); it is not proof of the supported Stable DMG transition. The Arch package path is exercised separately by arch_native_package_install_upgrade.

invariants: Create, edit, save, close, and reopen without source loss.
Source round-trips byte-for-byte, including front matter and [[...]] syntax.
Create, edit, save, close, reopen, and present.
Source round-trips byte-for-byte, including ordinary Markdown and literal document-link syntax.
Preview and presentation retain theme, typography, math, Mermaid, Art, and local media.
Export/import preserves source and media bytes.
A pre-manifest deck with a noncanonical top-level Markdown filename opens.
Compatible open/save/export/import preserves the exact Markdown bytes.
Stable does not activate excluded document linking for [[...]].
Unsupported directive text survives compatible save and .elef round-trip byte-for-byte.
The prior Stable app-data/library-root.json format points at the fixture library.
The existing path, deck identity, and source remain unchanged when the selected library is restored.
Packaged upgrade/relaunch preservation remains a separate acceptance check.
Stale save does not overwrite external bytes.
Local unsaved text remains available while conflict resolution is pending.
Unsafe close/update leaves the app open.
On macOS, stage signed N from N-1, interrupt and restart before activation, then verify cached integrity metadata is reused without redownloading.
A dirty-save conflict keeps the old app open and preserves both external bytes and the local draft; a later ordinary quit installs and relaunches N with the saved library source.
Invalid signature and version mismatch are rejected by the native stage command; central block and interrupted activation still need packaged cases.
No sentinel value appears in structured logs or exported diagnostics ZIP, including failure-category inputs and tampered exception, source, title, filename, path, token, secret, and IPC fields.
Native menu and dialog integration still needs runtime smoke coverage.

environment_notes: The full E2E command uses disposable fixtures, but can start a Rails test server on port 3000; do not run it while the user's development server occupies that port.
An expected exit code is not a result. Null observed exit codes and TODO statuses mean the acceptance scenario has not yet been run and passed.
